categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the design, development, production, and sales of optical resin lens products. Core segments include daily-use universal lenses across various refractive indices (1.56, 1.60, 1.67, 1.71, 1.74), functional lenses (myopia management lenses branded 'Qingsong Control', anti-blue light lenses, high-refractive-index lenses, progressive multifocal lenses), finished glasses (complete eyeglasses), lens raw materials, and eyeglass frames. The company also operates in lens material production and optical glass technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced optical design and manufacturing technologies including self-developed resin materials (KR resin, KR super-tough, PMC super-bright with 98.6% light transmittance), high-refractive-index lens technology (1.71 with Abbe number of 37), and proprietary myopia management technology using multi-point positive defocus (C.A.M.D) with 3D internal engraving producing 1,329 micro-lenses. Manufacturing capabilities include precision molding, advanced coating technologies, and digital transformation with SAP, MES, and WMS systems. The company has established collaborative research centers with universities and research institutions for optical design and material innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include eyeglass retail stores, eyeglass chain enterprises, optical medical institutions (hospitals and clinics), and online e-commerce platforms. The company serves consumers across all age groups with specific focus on youth myopia management (ages 6-18), elderly consumers requiring progressive multifocal lenses, and fashion-conscious consumers. End markets include retail eyeglass stores, medical/clinical channels, direct-to-consumer e-commerce, and experience showrooms. The company has established partnerships with major eye care institutions including Aier Eye Hospital and Wenzhou Medical University.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Shanghai and manufacturing facilities in Danyang, Jiangsu Province. The company has established a nationwide sales network covering all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in China. International presence includes a subsidiary in Singapore (Vivo Optics Pte.Ltd) and operations in Hong Kong. The company exports products internationally, with overseas revenue representing approximately 3.79% of total revenue in 2024. Domestic market accounts for 96.21% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in optical material production (self-developed resin raw materials and lens blanks through subsidiary Jiangsu Keoxi), midstream in lens manufacturing and processing, and downstream in finished lens sales and complete eyeglass assembly. The company has integrated vertically by establishing its own raw material production capabilities through partnerships with Japanese Mitsui and Korean KOC, making it one of few global lens companies achieving material self-sufficiency. The company supplies raw materials to industry peers while also purchasing from external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing myopia management technology with focus on youth eye health protection, evidenced by continuous product upgrades (Qingsong Control Pro 2.0 with 73.82% myopia progression reduction rate); (2) developing high-refractive-index and functional lens products to capture premium market segments; (3) expanding into AI smart glasses lens technology as an emerging opportunity; (4) deepening medical channel development through partnerships with eye hospitals and clinics; (5) pursuing international expansion and brand globalization through partnerships like the exclusive collaboration with German Leica announced in April 2024; (6) digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to achieve 99% 48-hour custom lens delivery rate; (7) establishing research centers with leading universities for optical design and material science breakthroughs.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales across multiple channels: (1) Direct sales to eyeglass retail stores and chains (57.43% of revenue in 2024), (2) Distribution through regional distributors (34.35% of revenue), (3) Direct-to-consumer e-commerce via platforms like Tmall and JD.com (7.41% of revenue), and (4) Experience showroom retail (0.81% of revenue). Revenue streams include lens sales (82.31% of total revenue), raw material sales (8.78%), finished glasses sales (6.92%), eyeglass frames (0.92%), and accessories (1.08%). The company employs a tiered pricing strategy with premium pricing for functional and high-refractive-index lenses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to Frost & Sullivan market research, Mingyue Optical Lens holds the #1 market position in China's branded lens retail market with 12.4% market share by volume in 2024, and has maintained 'nine consecutive years of national sales leadership' as of April 2025. The company is the only pure-play optical lens brand company listed on China's A-share market under the registration system. Competitors include international brands (Essilor, Hoya, Nikon) and domestic manufacturers. The company differentiates through superior R&D capabilities, proprietary materials, advanced manufacturing (48-hour delivery), strong brand recognition (endorsed by actors Chen Daoming and Liu Haoran), and strategic partnerships with institutions like Zhuang Songlin Academy and Leica.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized optical lens manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 770.3 million RMB, representing 2.88% growth from 2023 (748.7 million RMB). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 176.8 million RMB in 2024, up 12.21% year-over-year. The company maintains strong profitability with 58.56% gross margin and 10.99% return on equity. Total assets reached 1.86 billion RMB as of end-2024, up 6.18% from prior year. Operating cash flow was 211.2 million RMB in 2024. The company has demonstrated consistent growth trajectory with revenue CAGR of approximately 10.4% from 2022-2024, indicating stable mid-to-high growth profile in a maturing but expanding market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on: (1) Advanced proprietary technology including self-developed high-refractive-index lenses (1.71 with superior Abbe number of 37) and myopia management technology with clinically-proven efficacy (73.82% progression reduction); (2) Superior manufacturing capabilities enabling 48-hour custom lens delivery and 99.5% same-day finished glasses delivery; (3) Comprehensive product portfolio addressing diverse consumer needs across age groups and use cases; (4) Strong brand equity as China's #1 lens brand with national recognition; (5) Commitment to youth eye health through innovative myopia management solutions and public health initiatives; (6) Material self-sufficiency through proprietary raw material production reducing supply chain risk; (7) Strategic partnerships with global leaders (Leica) and research institutions enhancing innovation capability; (8) Customer-centric service model with extensive training, digital platforms, and professional support for retail partners.
